notes.title: Miko Gakkou: Second Year's original soundtrack is now available!
notes.notes:
We have heard your feedback, and are therefore happy to announce that the soundtrack for Miko Gakkou: Second Year is [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/432650?beta=0]now available[/url] for download in high quality DRM-free MP3 files as DLC!

Get it now with the initial 20% launch discount!

notes.title: Welcome to Ayanoyama School for Shrine Maidens!
notes.notes:
We are proud to announce that we have just released Miko Gakkou Monogatari: Kaede Episode on Steam.

For the following two weeks, our other game, [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/331290/]Miko Gakkou; Second Year[/url] will be available at a 20% discount, so make sure you get both games right now!

Have a great time on this winter break, and don't forget to mikomiko all the time!
